name: Necromancer
source: Written by Vorthas for Monster Builder for Pathfinder 2e, after Pathfinder GM Core's Class Road Maps ("Building Creatures")
license: GPL-3.0-or-later, like the rest of this app; the Pathfinder rules terms it uses are Paizo's ORC-licensed material.
rules: Low Perception; high Occultism; high Int, low AC; high Fortitude, low Reflex, moderate Will; low to moderate HP; low accuracy; high to extreme spell DC. Abilities: Prepared occult spellcasting as a necromancer of their level; grave spells, Create Thrall (two thralls, command thrall to move in same action), max cap of 4 thralls

notes.defense: Low AC; high Fortitude, low Reflex, moderate Will; low to moderate HP.
notes.spells: High to extreme spell DC. Prepared occult spellcasting as a necromancer of its level: {maxrank}. Grave spells.
notes.specials: Create Thrall (two thralls, and command a thrall to move, in the same action); at most 4 thralls.
